disposition: Caller-supplied WavLM acoustic disfluency source/weights/runtime readiness blocker; no implementation, adapter, asset or result.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply a written, reviewed license/terms grant covering the source code and the Google Drive checkpoint, plus a product-use and redistribution decision, before treating the candidate as usable.
exact_blockers.statement: The upstream checkout at commit a2512e5fa0d2bf200861f049a2f08a2600c3f27c contains no LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING or NOTICE file, and its README, demo and model definition declare no license, terms or redistribution grant. The Google Drive payload description also declares no terms. The exact source is present but unlicensed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply the immutable checkpoint with exact byte count and SHA-256 8724aaac4da9ae4d6e04f55dc394650a2517fbf529f5f4cd00b1353c74547036, an acquisition record and reviewed weight terms.
exact_blockers.statement: The 377,639,565-byte disfluency_acoustic.pt checkpoint is absent. Only its documented SHA-256 8724aaac... and Google Drive id 1wWrmopvvdhlBw-cL7EDyih9zn_IJu5Wr are recorded. No local file exists at the runner path, the checkout demo_models path, the model directories or the Hugging Face/torch caches, and nothing was downloaded or reconstructed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Pin the exact backbone configuration and weights used at training or prove the smoke configuration compatible, with per-file digests, the 40-hex revision and reviewed terms.
exact_blockers.statement: The repository constructs WavLMModel.from_pretrained('microsoft/wavlm-base'); the smoke instantiated the architecture from a local microsoft/wavlm-base-plus config at revision 4c66d48... because the checkpoint supplies all state. Neither the Base nor Base+ config/weights are present locally, and the Base+ model card records a null license field.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply a locked offline environment with exact Python/torch/transformers versions, wheel hashes, an install/import digest and a clean-room deterministic load of the pinned checkpoint.
exact_blockers.statement: The Python 3.10.13 / torch 2.2.2 / transformers 4.40.2 runtime is absent. data/envs is absent, the pinned interpreter exposes no torch or transformers, and the repository declares a different dependency set (torch 1.12.1, transformers 4.22.2, torchaudio 0.12.1, gdown 5.1.0). No import or inference was attempted.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze a permitted, speaker/meeting-disjoint cohort with verified per-frame labels for all five categories, reviewed corpus and annotation terms, language/speaker groups and timestamps.
exact_blockers.statement: No rights-cleared frame-labeled disfluency cohort is staged. The historical run used one AMI EN2003a crop as an unlabeled smoke; AMI provides no matching framewise FP/RP/RV/RS/PW labels. The upstream labels derive from Switchboard and a corrected annotation archive whose LDC/annotation terms are not reviewed here, and no audio byte was read for this package.

exact_blockers.required_action: Reproduce the detector on the qualified cohort with a frozen scorer, per-label precision/recall/F1, onset/offset delay, stratified FN/FP, nonspeech separation and missing/adverse/nonfinite controls, then complete Rate-profile, target-device timing and a separate OFF-by-default intake.
exact_blockers.statement: No accuracy, onset/offset, stratified error or finite-output result was reproduced. The smoke reports 199 frame outputs and positive RP=10 / PW=3 counts on one crop with no reference labels; it is not precision, recall, F1 or a qualifying result. No Rate-profile, device-timing, listening or provider intake evidence exists.

non_claims: No WavLM weight, disfluency checkpoint or backbone asset is present.
No torch, transformers or other model runtime is imported or executed.
No audio, transcript or frame disfluency label is read or scored.
No precision, recall, F1, onset/offset or finite-output result is reproduced.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
A frame-level disfluency probability is not a speed factor or a TSM setting.

quality_outcomes.evidence: No reference frame labels or reproduced precision/recall/F1 exist; the smoke positive counts are not scores.
No aligned frame labels or onset/offset timing comparison exists.
No quiet/active, speaker, label, or nonspeech stratification exists.
No missing-input, malformed-input, nonfinite-audio or all-negative control was exercised against the real model.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: The candidate is a frame-level classifier, not a TSM renderer; no source/output mapping or rendered duration exists.
No rendered output, F0/transient metric or listening result exists.
No playback chain, queue, fill/flush or buffering measurement exists.
No 1x or rate-change comparison exists; frame probabilities are not a speed factor.
The historical smoke is one AMI speech crop; no unfamiliar speech, language, music or silence coverage was tested.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, clock-drift or partial-window behavior was measured.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: The smoke emits frame logits without source-timestamp decisions, a deletion policy or any speech-preservation measurement.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: A disfluency detector is not a rate estimator, and no preference or acceptability labels map detections to a preferred speed.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map estimated rate to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Pin the exact source tree and commit and stage a reviewed license/terms grant plus a product-use and redistribution decision.
release_gates.statement: The repository commit is pinned and present, but no license or terms are declared for the source or the checkpoint.
release_gates.title: source_revision_and_license_provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Supply the immutable checkpoint and exact backbone assets with per-file byte counts, SHA-256, revisions and reviewed terms.
release_gates.statement: The 377,639,565-byte checkpoint and the WavLM backbone config/weights are absent; only digests and a null-license source record exist.
release_gates.title: weights_checkpoint_and_backbone_assets

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide a locked offline runtime, load the pinned checkpoint with networking disabled, verify all state keys and record deterministic repeat outputs.
release_gates.statement: The exact Python/torch/transformers runtime is absent and no offline load was executed.
release_gates.title: pinned_runtime_and_offline_load

release_gates.reopen_condition: Freeze a permitted, speaker/meeting-disjoint cohort with verified frame labels, reviewed corpus/annotation terms and timestamps.
release_gates.statement: No permitted cohort with framewise FP/RP/RV/RS/PW labels is staged; AMI lacks matching frame labels.
release_gates.title: rights_cleared_frame_labeled_cohort

release_gates.reopen_condition: Reproduce the detector with a frozen scorer and report per-label quality, onset/offset delay, stratified FN/FP, nonspeech separation, finite-output and baseline/adverse controls.
release_gates.statement: No precision, recall, F1, onset/offset delay, stratified error or missing/adverse/nonfinite control result exists.
release_gates.title: frame_level_detection_quality_and_controls

release_gates.reopen_condition: Score the exact Rate-profile cases with separate source references and a reviewed timestamp-tied pause/filler policy that preserves speech.
release_gates.statement: The Rate profile is not exercised: no mapping, duration, pitch/transient, buffering, rate-change, unfamiliar speech/music/silence, rebuffer/drift, final-partial-window or timestamp-tied pause/filler preservation evidence exists.
release_gates.title: rate_profile_condition_coverage_and_preservation

release_gates.reopen_condition: Measure the exact installed candidate under paced workload with p50/p95/p99 latency, RTF, CPU/memory/energy and deadline behavior on the intended device.
release_gates.statement: No target-device p50/p95/p99 latency, RTF, resource, thermal or deadline measurement exists; the single historical 180 ms CPU smoke is context only.
release_gates.title: target_timing_resources_and_deadlines

release_gates.reopen_condition: Open a separate versioned, OFF-by-default provider intake with an exact descriptor/config, clean-install proof and independent exact-head review after all prior gates clear.
release_gates.statement: No provider, adapter, descriptor or intake exists; the installed v0 geometry and shared build remain untouched.
release_gates.title: provider_intake_public_surface_and_release

required_artifacts.requirement: The pinned research scorecard, detailed neural report, exact inference-smoke runner and output, WavLM Base+ source record and shared 210-window AMI manifest.
A reviewed license/terms grant for the repository at commit a2512e5fa0d2bf200861f049a2f08a2600c3f27c. The checkout has no LICENSE file and the README declares no license.
The exact 377,639,565-byte acoustic.pt checkpoint with SHA-256 8724aaac4da9ae4d6e04f55dc394650a2517fbf529f5f4cd00b1353c74547036 and reviewed weight terms.

The exact WavLM backbone configuration/weights required to instantiate the architecture (microsoft/wavlm-base per the repository, or the recorded Base+ smoke configuration), with per-file digests and reviewed terms.
A locked offline runtime with Python 3.10.13, torch 2.2.2, transformers 4.40.2, numpy/soundfile loaders and an install/import digest.
A rights-cleared speech cohort with per-frame FP/RP/RV/RS/PW labels, reviewed Switchboard/LDC and annotation terms, speaker/meeting groups and source timestamps.
Reproduced per-label precision/recall/F1, onset/offset delay, stratified FN/FP, nonspeech separation, and missing/adverse/nonfinite controls on the qualified cohort.
Rate-profile mapping, pause/filler timestamp and preservation evidence, target-device timing/resources, and a separate OFF-by-default provider intake after all prior gates clear.

required_results: Reviewed license/terms for the source repository and the checkpoint.
The exact checkpoint with byte count and SHA-256, plus backbone assets.
Rights-cleared cohort with verified framewise FP/RP/RV/RS/PW labels.
Per-label precision/recall/F1, onset/offset delay and stratified errors.
Missing, adverse, all-negative and nonfinite controls against the model.
Rate-profile mapping, pause/filler timestamp and preservation evidence.
Target-device p50/p95/p99 timing, resources and deadline behavior.
Separate OFF-by-default provider intake and independent exact-head review.

timing_requirements.evidence: Only one historical 180.36 ms model-only CPU observation exists; no local p50/p95 measurement was made.
No device, pacing or callback deadline was measured.
No resource, thermal or energy measurement exists.
